title: Tempo Loses to Dream
summary: The Dream handed the Tempo another loss, extending their losing skid to 9 games. The Tempo's rough stretch may have potential benefits in the 2027 lottery. The losing streak has raised questions about the team's performance. The Tempo's current situation has been compared to a potential advantage in the future. The team's struggles have been a subject of discussion.
summary_points: The Dream defeated the Tempo, adding to their losing streak.
The Tempo's losing skid has reached 9 games.
The team's rough stretch may lead to benefits in the 2027 lottery.
The losing streak has sparked conversation about the team's performance.
The Tempo's current struggles are being viewed as a potential future advantage.
